title: Mixed Event — Relaxing Tea Time

meta.Outline: In the lead-up to White Day, Kanade begins thinking about how to express her gratitude for the Valentine's chocolate she received, as well as for all the help she's been given. As she's struggling to think of gifts, she learns that Ichika is having the same dilemma, and the two team up!

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
The bridge transitions into the last chorus seamlessly now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I might actually be able to finish this demo before Mafuyu comes back from school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just a little bit more to—

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I didn't have lunch today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I should eat something...
But I also want to finish what I'm doing...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I know...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Those chocolate the others gave me for Valentine's Day should be... Ah, here they are.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mmm... They're so good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (How many people did I receive chocolates from in the end?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's Ena, Mizuki...and Ms. Mochizuki... I really need to thank them again.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: White Day is coming up...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should do something to give back to all of them. So, Ena, Mizuki, Ms. Mochizuki and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is a good opportunity for me to give back to everyone who always supports me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which includes Miku and the others... And Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I think that's everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, hold on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What am I supposed to give them exactly?
The next morning
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it was.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You can stay seated. I'll wash the dishes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, Mafuyu, are you leaving for school already? I was hoping to ask you a quick question...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A quick question?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like to give back to everyone who's been supporting me on White Day, but I'm not sure what to get them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which is why I was wondering if you already know what you're going to give people.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My plan is to buy some snacks or sweets at a store. Most places are holding White Day fairs around this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see... Do you have a particular store in mind?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Not yet...
Probably some place that people are talking about, or one that simply catches my attention.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. That helps a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I guess it's normal for people to give each other storebought gifts...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It'd be nice to make something again. I really liked those scented candles I made with Ms. Mochizuki and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I doubt I'll be able to make anything all on my own... And it would probably be hard to get together as a group again.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which means buying something may be my best option.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I want to give everyone something they'd actually want. Something that'd make them happy...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try asking them what they want.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, I'm gonna log off now since this seems like a good place to stop!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. My sketch is done, so I'm gonna go to bed.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you both for your hard work.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, wait... Can I ask you two something before you go?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? What's up?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm thinking about getting everyone something for White Day. What would you two like to have?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I dunno. There's so much...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hmm... Cheesecake is my go-to...
But if it's you getting me something, K, then... Hmm...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, you could get me one of Kinsendo's limited-edition chocolate cakes♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Uhh... A limited-edition chocolate cake from Kinsendo... Got it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait a second!
They only make ten of those each year, Amia! How do you expect her to get her hands on one?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, is that true...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. Sorry!
I thought I'd just try floating it out there.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To be honest, K, I'll be happy with whatever you give me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. Choose whatever you feel is right.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll do that... Thank you both.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How about you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm also okay with whatever.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <O-Okay... Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They're all okay with whatever I get...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So, what do I get them...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm logging off. See you all later!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Me too. Don't work too hard, K, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh... Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Good night.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll go pour us some tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll need to think about this some more...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A message? Who's sending me one at this hour...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Hoshino?
The next day
Diner

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: ...is probably the best way I know to get a bass drum to sound more punchy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see. I didn't know that was possible...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's common for bass drums to create a lot of unwanted noise, but an equalizer can help you get the sound you want by filtering all that out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you should try reading this book if you have time. It discusses this topic in much further detail.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you so much!
If you're sure, then I'll borrow this for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Where do I begin to thank you...
You've given me such a thorough explanation after I asked you to meet me on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm just glad that I could help you...
So, have you gotten used to composing on a computer?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, there's still so much I don't know. I actually stayed up really late last night working on a song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But my hope is that I'll soon be able to produce songs the way I imagine them as easily as you do, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I'm sure you will.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Please feel free to contact me again.
I'll try to answer your questions as best I can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't realize I was this hungry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, why don't we get a quick bite to eat?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, please!
Alright, what's on the menu... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Only available on White Day”...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Gratin with white sauce, roasted marshmallow cakes, tarts topped with towers of whipped cream... They have quite a lot on here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They do...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
This menu made me think about White Day is all..

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The thing is, I haven't been able to decide what I'm going to get everyone for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes...
I've also been having the same problem.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? You too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I still haven't been able to decide either...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so hard. Especially after hearing all my friends say that they'll be happy with whatever I get them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I was told the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We're in the same boat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We are...
At the same time, I'd probably answer the same way as everyone if I were asked what I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But that's the strange part...
It's always so hard to decide what to get when you're the one doing the giving.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: True...
We couldn't help but overhear your conversation!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Minori...! Oh, Momoi's with you...!
How long have you two been here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We apologize for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But your conversation caught our attention while we were discussing an idea for a stream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I wish we'd noticed sooner.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's okay because...we might be able to help with your problem!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're both wondering about what to give everyone for White Day, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We actually got a question about that during one of our streams and were just in the middle of planning a special segment in response!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're calling it...
The White Day Gift Showcase Special!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sh-Showcase...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does that mean you're going to recommend gifts for White Day?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone by the name of OneMillionFriends sent us the question I just mentioned, and they're having trouble deciding what to get everyone for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: One million friends...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's probably just their handle, but I'm guessing they do have a lot of friends to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
So, what did they ask specifically?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What was it now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Dear Minori,
I'm a huge fan of you and MORE MORE JUMP! I'm having trouble deciding what to get all my friends for White Day.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Despite my limited budget, I want to get everyone something really nice. What would you all do in this kind of situation?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...is what they wrote!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you memorized the whole thing...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. They did say that they're a huge fan of mine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we're turning this person's idea into an entire segment about affordable White Day gifts!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's just what we need...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess we're not alone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Now do you see?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were just about to browse around a few shops to see what's out there...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, why don't you two join us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
We've been looking up what kinds of snacks and sweets everyone's buying, so we can all go look at those in person today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it would also be great to get an outsider's perspective.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Just browsing, no cameras! So you should both come with us!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Hanasato and... Um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm Airi Momoi.
It's nice to meet you, Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Nice to meet you too.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, we're here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The mall...?
We're shopping here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! A lot of shops are holding fairs right now, so I'm sure we'll find tons of different gift options!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She's right...
Almost every store seems to be covered in decorations.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It is that time of year.
Anyway, let's start checking a few out, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Here's our first stop!
Sweets Love Sweets! They make all sorts of yummy Western treats!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Cookies, candy, marshmallows...
They've got all the White Day classics!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And they have all different options for wrapping. The others might really like this star-studded design...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that one's really cute.
Plus, they're individually wrapped, so it's easy to hand them out to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This is incredible...
Oh, and you can also get a variety pack with an assortment of different sweets.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Those also work great as gifts since the odds of the recipient finding something they like go way up!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: True... With that many options, they're bound to like something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you still seem undecided.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um... I'm sorry...
A big assortment isn't a bad idea, but I think I'm still leaning towards more individualized gifts.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have to agree with Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's perfectly fine.
This is just the tip of the iceberg. We still have plenty of shops left to visit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, let's check out this shop next!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A candy store?
When did this open...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like they carry all sorts of candy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, check out these! They look like real gems!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Candy cut like jewels...
I'm not sure I'd be able to tell the difference if someone placed these next to actual gems.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shops that specialize in one thing always have so much fun stuff!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, look what I found!
A huge lollipop...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow, it's covering up most of your face.
You could even use it as a fan.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We gotta show this on our stream!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think I could finish this even if I had the entire day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, a caramel shop...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, that sweet aroma! It smells so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, did you two know that the snacks you give for White Day can mean different things?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I've heard that.
Giving someone candy is supposed to be the same as confessing your love to them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Do you know any other examples?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... I think cookies symbolize friendship, and caramel signifies feeling comfortable around that person.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...
I guess we should keep those things in mind while choosing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I wonder?
I feel like getting something they'll actually like is more important.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But knowing what  message you want to send could help narrow down your choices.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Message...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry! We've still got plenty of shops left to check out!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's keep thinking while seeing what's available!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that shop specializes in macarons!
Let's go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... We've checked out a lot of shops now. Did anything stand out to either of you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, everything we saw seemed really nice. They all looked beautiful and delicious...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But none seemed just right.
I kept hesitating every time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. Even after all the help you've given us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's okay!
We've been able to see more than enough shops for our research!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. And we've come this far together, so let's keep looking for that perfect gift!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still, why am I having so much trouble choosing...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hanasato and Momoi helped us find some really nice options.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But none of them seemed quite right...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, next let's—
Oh, we've covered just about all the shops here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about we head back towards the station for now and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, is that...Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She did say she was going to buy gifts for White Day.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hello, Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello, Momoi.
Oh, Kanade, Hoshino... Were you all doing something together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, long story short, we're here looking for White Day gifts with Hanasato and Momoi's help...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, really? I'm here for the same reason.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was just looking for some nice White Day gifts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina, in that case!
Are there any shops you recommend?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Uh, any that I recommend...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! We've been to basically all the ones here, but haven't been able to find the right gifts...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, how about that one shop?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which one?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A trinket shop that opened up right nearby. One of my classmates recommended that I go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A trinket shop...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was just about to head over there after finding out that the sweets I was going to get for my classmates were all sold out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, some of my classmates also mentioned that a cute shop had opened up around here...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to go with you to this store?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course.
I'll lead the way.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, we're here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, they have so much cute stuff!
And...at reasonable prices too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is my first time actually visiting, but I'd heard they have a nice selection of goods.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, they apparently carry quite a few rare items.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A cute trinket might work just as well as snacks when it comes to White Day...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Valentine's Day is usually all about chocolates, but many people seem to give each other cosmetics and little gifts like these for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it is nice that we have those as options...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. We might just be able to find what we're looking for here...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's start looking!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.
Ten minutes later

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Excuse me.
I'd like to have all of these wrapped as gifts.

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I'll get started on these right away. In the meantime, please feel free to continue browsing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Understood. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Is this a sketchbook...?
It's tiny, but Ena might really like it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And this looks like a fancy teaspoon...
Ms. Mochizuki would... Wait, she probably already has one like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is still really hard...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't think that you should think so hard about this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Those two would probably love to receive this sketchbook and teaspoon from you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know they'd like these...
But it doesn't seem like enough to just get them gifts that they'll enjoy. It just doesn't feel right for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you looking for that perfect reason?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm not sure.
But I feel like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if you just want Ena and the others to feel super duper happy?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's what I always end up thinking when I'm choosing gifts for people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I find myself wondering if they're really going to feel happy about what I get them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want them to feel happy...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This sketchbook and teaspoon are really nice, but a part of me must've been wondering if there's anything out there that would make them feel even happier.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I get how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I might've been wondering the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Minori, how do you decide in these situations?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me? I, uhh... Well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll start by learning as much as I can about the person I'm giving to!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Learn about them? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, when I was still in junior high, I gave Haruka something...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I got her a pen holder in the shape of a penguin.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, she really does love penguins.
But why a pen holder?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That was actually my first time sending her a gift...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I read all the magazine articles and social media posts I could to find something that she'd really like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was when I found an article where she said, “My current hobby is collecting cute pens”...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I started looking with that quote in mind, and I found that penguin pen holder!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was sure she'd love it, so I bought it and sent it to her agency!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She must have, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! She even posted it to social media after she received it. Researching what to get her was really hard, but I'm glad I put in all that effort.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Actually, I remember her mentioning this pen holder a while back. She's apparently still using it to this day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I always think really long and hard about the person who's going to receive my gift!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Well, here I go...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can do it, Kanade...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hand on the lid to keep it from spilling...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And pour into the cup... Carefully...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Geez, Ena, don't be so overprotective.
But also, that smells amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
We're outside, but we're still getting the full treatment!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It smells delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you all very much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Anyway, Ms. Mochizuki, here's your cup.
While it's still warm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'll try it now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your cups will be ready soon, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki, just give me one second.
I'll start pouring for you and the others.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
This smells wonderful...
Lemon and ginger? Is that right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it's ginger tea.
You said your shoulders were sore, and I was told about how this can help improve blood flow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Ms. Yoisaki.
That's so thoughtful of you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, what's this one called?
It smells so sweet and gentle!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's this shop's own original blend that includes...um, chamomile and lavender... It's supposed to be very soothing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you're very busy as idols, so I tried finding something that could help you relax and recover.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This smells really nice, and it has such a soothing flavor... Thank you both for going through all this trouble!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? This tea... It tastes like... Peppermint? It's got that refreshing feel to it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena, yours is... Spearmint tea...
It's supposed to be refreshing like you said, so it should help you study and sleep better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on. Did you two get different types of tea for everybody here?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, we made our choices based on things you told us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you put that much thought into this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, you got this just for me...?
I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm going to savor every drop!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay, but I can always pour you some more...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... That's everyone for now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They all seem to be having a nice, relaxing time.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, whoa...! You're the “Ena” I've heard so much about, Shinonome?! The one who's in the same group as Asahina?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've seen your videos!
I love them so much!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Ena's really an incredible artist.
You should see some of her drawings and paintings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've seen her art too, and I remember being blown away by it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Th-They're really not that great.
Yes, I can draw, but only because I attend an art class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but you sure sound pretty happy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a tea party, so... I should try to talk to some people.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But, who...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hanasato and Momoi...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ichika invited you, right? Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for not coming to talk to you sooner. Here, let's have some of these snacks together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Let's all talk over here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Let's go, you two!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me too...? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! Come on! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They all seem to be enjoying themselves. But...)
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you again for coming.
So, how's the tea...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel a bit relaxed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yours is linden tea, Mafuyu.
It's supposed to have a very soothing floral flavor.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I steeped it properly, but I hope it helped a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You really got a particular kind of tea just for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, yes.
Let me know if you'd like some more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry if I caused you any trouble, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm really glad that you decided to join us for this tea party...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You didn't cause me any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't say whether or not it's this tea, but... I don't feel all that bothered.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wouldn't mind doing something like this again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (At first, I had so much trouble figuring out what to get everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm glad we gave it so much thought and decided to hold this tea party.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I'm incredibly glad that everyone's getting this chance to take a break from their busy schedules to have a nice, relaxing time.)
